name: display
title: world.display
lead: A model stands in the world through the same call as everything else, and is the one kind that hands back something other than a Display.
signature: world.display((opts: { kind: "model", model: Model, at: Vec3 ?, rotation: Orientation ?, scale: (number | Vec3)?, -- models require equal positive axes paint: { [string]: Ink }?, fallback: string ?, seats: { Vec3 }?, lead: boolean ?, }) -> ModelDisplay) → & ((opts: { kind: "item" | "text" | "block" | "frame", at: Vec3 ?, rotation: Orientation ?, scale: (Vec3 | number)?, billboard: Billboard ?, glow: (Ink | false)?, item: ItemSpec ?, canvas: Canvas ?, context: Context ?, text: Text ?, color: Ink ?, background: (Ink | false)?, line_width: number ?, shadow: boolean ?, block: string ?, facing: ScreenFacing ?, invisible: boolean ?, glide: number ?, lead: boolean ?, }) -> Display)
